servinfo.title: Forward Impact Sensor Removal and Installation

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when handling the air bag system sensor can result in personal injury due to non-deployed air bag system in the event of an accident or accidental air bag deployment.

item.ptxt: Never impact or shake the sensor. Otherwise, proper operation of the sensor cannot be assured.
Always tighten the mounting bolt to specified torque when installing the sensor. Otherwise, proper operation of the sensor cannot be assured.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect forward impact sensor connector (2) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Release locking slider (1) by sliding it in arrow direction “1”.
Disconnect forward impact sensor connector by pulling it in arrow direction “2”.

s1.ptxt: Remove forward impact sensor bolt (3) and remove forward impact sensor (4) from front side member (5).
Check that none of the following faulty conditions exists.

item.ptxt: Bend, deformation or rust on right-side lamp support member

s1.ptxt: Align mounting pin (1) to mounting hole (2) of vehicle to install forward impact sensor (3).
Tighten forward impact sensor bolt to specified torque.
Connect forward impact sensor connector securely.
